title: method payload
description: A design decision: the approach a paper took to a sub-problem. Carries no numeric value, so METHOD_CONFLICT is the only detector that can see a disagreement here.

sub_problem.description: Normalized name of what is being decided, e.g. sentence_level_objective. Two papers align on this, not on the approach.

approach.description: The approach as the paper names it, e.g. 'next sentence prediction (NSP)'.

adopted.description: false when the paper explicitly rejects or removes this approach. RoBERTa removing NSP is a claim about NSP, not an absence of one.

alternatives_rejected.description: Approaches the paper considered and did not take.

rationale.description: The reason the paper gives, if it gives one. Never inferred.

attribution.description: Whether this is the paper's own decision or a description of what another paper does. A background section explaining a predecessor's design is not a decision by the paper containing it.
